evals.prompt: Create a true-isometric orthographic Blender cottage kit with 2 m cells and center pivots.
assertions: Uses equal-axis view direction and verifies it.
Keeps 2 m grid and shared pivots.

evals.prompt: A 2:1 dimetric kit was rebuilt with perspective and each tile has a different crop. Repair it.
assertions: Does not confuse true iso and dimetric.

evals.prompt: Calibrate a square-grid 2:1 dimetric tile camera at 45-degree azimuth with square output pixels. Preserve a separate existing true-isometric camera and provide an adjacent-tile comparison.
evals.expected_output: A declared dimetric camera with measured 2:1 projected ground diamond, shared scale and distinct true-iso contract.
assertions: Uses 30-degree ground elevation for the stated diagonal orthographic conditions.
Checks rendered/projected diamond ratio rather than Euler fields alone.
Does not distort meshes to hide camera mismatch or claim depth sorting.
